author: reek
body: Every line of this used to be a literal. "Agent: no agent loaded", "Registry: 0 agents" and "GPU Bridge: not initialized" were the answers whatever the machine held, so an operator who had put a signed agent on the boot image was told there was none, in the same words as an operator who had not. Worse, none of it ran: `handle-console-input` did not route ModeAgent at all, so the menu drew and then swallowed every key, Back included, and the only way out of the Agent Manager was to reboot.

author: reek
body: The role sub-menu shares ModeAgent, so the title decides which of the two key sets a keystroke belongs to. This is `dispatch-drive-menu`'s arrangement and it is here for the same reason: a mode per sub-menu would multiply ConsoleMode by every menu depth.

author: reek
body: A role switch with no agent to switch says so rather than reporting the new role, which would be a console telling the operator it had done something to nothing.
